class: EXPLORATORY / PROVISIONAL until canonical first-touch audits
reference_engine: scripts/s2_current_rule_5y.py existing official Binance 1m for parent collisions
setup: at exact 15m OPEN; fresh crossing at least 5/6 of 7 Bollinger(20,2) upper or lower TF bands. Open-time BB uses 19 completed TF closes plus live OPEN. All 7 TF must have intact history. Frozen upper/lower band levels at setup.

confirmation.FIRST_BODY: first confirmed 15m candle with opposite colored body among setup candle and next 3; enter next 15m OPEN
confirmation.BREAK_SETUP_EXTREME: first completed later 15m close below setup low (SHORT), above setup high (LONG), within next 4 bars; enter next open
confirmation.RETURN_15M: first completed 15m close within frozen setup 15m upper/lower BB within 4 bars; only when setup 15m was outside its own band; enter next open

time_cutoff: confirmation must be observed after setup, entry at next exact 15m OPEN; reject entry past target
target: rank breached upper/lower TF bands by distance from setup OPEN; far2/far3; freeze target at setup time
exit: market-entry next 15m OPEN, TP frozen BB, SL as % from actual entry, official Binance 1m for entry-parent or TP/SL-collision cases, time exit on first 15m open at 4h; same-symbol overlap forbidden per config
limitations: point-in-time universe not guaranteed due frozen currently available symbols
market fills idealized at 15m open; slippage modeled as all-in roundtrip 20/40bp
selection: exploratory scan; do not claim clean OOS confirmation; report all configs including failures
criteria: positive expectancy and PF>1 at 40bp both chronological splits, and portfolio MDD+occupancy audited before candidate promotion
companion_diagnostic: symmetric lower band raw 15m/1h/4h revisit hit rates and upward MAE
postponed: 1m/5m confirmation requires full official 1m corpus, not inferred from 15m OHLC; if not completed in this run mark untested
